title: Credit Department Notice: SafeStep Programs during a Credit Hold, and Tier Changes
content:
# SafeStep Programs and the Customer's Credit Account

## Suspension and reinstatement

When the customer's Commercial Credit Account is placed on hold the program is suspended under the tier's credit hold redemption rule, and it is reinstated when the account is active again.

| Event on the customer's Commercial Credit Account | Effect on the SafeStep Safety Footwear & Eyewear Program |
|---|---|
| The account is placed on hold | An active program is suspended; redemptions are suspended under the tier's credit hold redemption rule |
| The account is active again | The suspended program is reinstated; redemptions resume |

- The suspension moves the program from active to suspended; it is made by the system when the hold is placed.
- The reinstatement moves the program from suspended back to active, after the credit hold is released, and is made by Customer Care.
- Under the rule "suspend all", redemptions are suspended while the account is on hold. Under the rule "honor issued vouchers", vouchers issued before the suspension are still honored on the suspended program.

## Tier changes

A tier change takes effect from the next allowance year. A program that moves to another tier during an allowance year keeps its current tier for the rest of that allowance year, and the new tier applies from the first day of the next one.
